workstreams.emptyDescription: Workstreams are execution units that bring initiatives to life. Each workstream contains the specific artifacts needed for execution: audiences, creatives, journeys, and experiments.
workstreams.example1: Q1 Email Campaign - Welcome series and lifecycle emails
workstreams.example2: Social Launch - Paid and organic social for product launch
workstreams.example3: Retention Flow - Churn prevention and win-back

prs.title: Pull Requests
prs.emptyDescription: Pull requests represent proposed changes to marketing artifacts. When you approve planner runs or create new artifacts, they can be converted into pull requests for review and deployment.
prs.example1: Strategic Plan PR - Q1 Campaign Goals and Initiatives
prs.example2: Tactical Plan PR - Email Campaign Creative Assets

learn.title: Learn
learn.emptyDescription: The Learn screen provides AI-powered insights and recommendations based on your marketing execution data. As you run campaigns and generate artifacts, the system will analyze performance patterns and suggest optimizations.
learn.example1: Campaign Performance Analysis - Best performing audience segments
learn.example2: Creative Optimization - Top performing message variations
learn.example3: Timing Insights - Optimal send times for email campaigns

assets.title: Assets
assets.emptyDescription: Assets are creative files, images, documents, and other media used in your marketing campaigns. Upload assets from Figma, import from external sources, or generate them through Studio Agent.
assets.example1: Figma Design Assets - Brand logos, campaign banners, social media graphics
assets.example2: Generated Content - AI-created images, copy variations, video thumbnails
assets.example3: Imported Files - PDFs, images, documents from external sources
